name: BINACOM
recent: BINACOM 正在推进私下配售新股计划，Bursa Securities 已于 2026 年 10 月 15 日批准最多 60,428,500 股配售股的上市。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开特别股东大会，寻求股东批准变更 2025 年 9 月完成的私募所募资金的用途。此外，公司近期出现首席财务官等主要管理人员的变动。
notable: Bursa Securities 批准公司私下配售最多 60,428,500 股新股的上市。
公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开特别股东大会，寻求股东批准变更 2025 年 9 月完成的私募所募资金的用途。
公司首席财务官 Leong Lian Jia 及另一名主要管理人员 Chan Ai Joo 出现变动。
risks: 私下配售最多 60,428,500 股新股，可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。

recent_en: BINACOM is proceeding with a proposed private placement of new shares, with Bursa Securities approving the listing of up to 60,428,500 placement shares on 15 October 2026. There have also been recent changes in principal officers, including the CFO.
notable_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 60,428,500 new placement shares under the proposed private placement.
There were changes in principal officers, including CFO Leong Lian Jia and another principal officer Chan Ai Joo.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 60,428,500 new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The company proposes to vary the utilisation of proceeds from its previous private placement.
